# M9: Drawing music: signs, lengths, boxes, home signs; black keys answer

Goal: the notation engine can draw everything part 2 needs and the keyboard reports black keys.
Shown only in the Gallery (no lesson uses it yet). Spec: SPEC §8.3, §8.4, §8.5; CURRICULUM §9
(libraries, transcribed here as data).

## Steps
1. **Glyphs:** add the 12 glyphs of §8.4 to `tools/glyphs/extract.py` `WANT`; regenerate
   `src/notation/glyphs.ts` with the commands in the script's header (Python venv, `fonttools==4.60.1`,
   Bravura from raw.githubusercontent.com; checked reachable from a cloud session on 2026-10-14).
   Do not commit `Bravura.otf` or the venv. Update `glyphs.test.ts`.
2. **Music text** (`domain/music.ts` + tests): types, `beatsOf`, `parseRhythm`, `parseMusic`,
   `soundingPitch`, `soundingCard` (§8.3). Test the sounding-pitch rule with every melody in sets
   MS, MF, MK, MN (expected card for **every** note written out in the test).
3. **Libraries** (`domain/library.ts`): every rhythm pattern, event set, melody and stack from
   CURRICULUM §9, transcribed exactly, parsed at load. Data tests from §8.3 (box sums, all
   sounding pitches are cards, staff positions, grand box counts).
4. **Music geometry** (`notation/musicGeometry.ts`, pure, tested as §8.4 lists) and the
   `Music.tsx` component (modes treble / bass / grand / rhythm; header; grid; notes, stems,
   dots, beams, signs, rests, stacks; marked note; states; empty slot).
5. **Keyboard** (§8.5): black keys report `{ black: midi }`, have accessible names and states;
   part-1 behaviour unchanged (black key still wrong there; existing e2e must stay green).
6. **Gallery:** a "Part 2" section with every glyph, every rhythm pattern, every melody, every
   stack set, a marked note, an empty slot, home signs G/F/D/B♭ on both clefs, time 2/3/4, and a
   keyboard with black keys highlighted and labelled.
7. **Visual QA:** extend `e2e/screens.spec.ts` to screenshot the Gallery's part-2 section at 390
   and 320 px, light and dark. Open every image; check SPEC §8.4 against the visual checklist
   (STANDARDS §7) — stems on the correct side, dots in spaces, signs not touching heads, notes
   that play together lined up on the grand staff, staff space ≥ 9 px at 320 px.
8. Update `HANDOFF.md` and `NOTES.md`. `npm run verify` green; "debug again" pass. Open the PR.
   In the PR, attach (link) the Gallery screenshots for the **owner to approve the look**, like M3.

## Review step (Opus)
Review prompt from `docs/build/README.md` with M9. The reviewer opens every screenshot and
checks the music against the rules in §8.4 note by note for at least t1, s1, kd1, h1, h6 and
every rhythm pattern in RE.

## Acceptance
- Every library item parses and draws correctly; the owner approved the look.
- Part-1 screens unchanged. `npm run verify` green.
